headline_item.title_zh: 2026年大型IPO表现疲软，AI板块估值遇冷
headline_item.title_en: Wall Street's 10 biggest IPOs of 2026, including SpaceX, SK, and Cerebras, have fallen by an average of 20.5% from their offer prices, as the AI frenzy fades (Emily Herbert/Financial Times)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 2026年十大IPO表现逊色，较发行价平均下跌20.5%，反映出市场对AI热潮引发的过高溢价回归理性
headline_item.event_summary_en: The top 10 IPOs of 2026, including SpaceX, SK, and Cerebras, have declined by an average of 20.5% from their offer prices as the AI investment frenzy cools. SpaceX raised $75 billion (up to $86.2 billion with overallotment) on June 12, 2026, while Anthropic filed confidentially on June 1 for an IPO aiming to rival SpaceX's capital-raising record and secure a valuation exceeding $2 trillion.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】SpaceX（航天科技公司）、Anthropic（AI模型研发商）在美国资本市场（纽约证券交易所/纳斯达克）：2026年大型IPO标的破发率高，Anthropic计划通过超大规模IPO挑战SpaceX融资纪录
【起因与机理】AI领域过热预期消退，资本对高估值科技资产的盈利兑现能力产生质疑
【关键数据与实测】2026年大型IPO平均破发20.5%，市场AI叙事吸引力下降。
【各方立场与态度】Anthropic拟通过保密申报寻求超越SpaceX的融资规模与2万亿估值。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] SpaceX, Anthropic (US Capital Markets): High post-IPO price depreciation among major 2026 listings; Anthropic targets record-breaking IPO
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Market fatigue from AI-driven valuations and shifting investor focus toward tangible profitability
[Key Metrics] Average 20.5% decline in 2026 top IPOs highlights cooling AI sentiment.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Anthropic targets a $2 trillion valuation and record funding, potentially challenging the current market trend.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此次破发潮标志着AI赛道一级市场向二级市场传导的估值泡沫开始破裂，资金正从单纯的参数规模崇拜转向对现金流与商业化落地的硬性评估。Anthropic若强行在高利率与情绪回落环境下完成万亿级融资，极大概率引发后续二级市场的持续性估值重构，加剧AI独角兽的流动性枯竭压力。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The wave of post-IPO depreciation signals a repricing of the AI sector, shifting focus from hyper-scale training capacity to viable commercial cash flows. Anthropic’s attempt to reach a $2 trillion valuation in a cooling market risks severe liquidity crunches and forced downward revisions, indicating that the era of speculative AI exuberance is yielding to fundamental valuation scrutiny.

人类的灵魂。

她不畏惧时间的流逝，也不追求永生。

因为即使世界忘记了她的名字，她体内的龙也会记得。

钢铁可以保护肉体，但只有灵魂才能使其永恒。

也许人类最美丽的事情是，即使在一个完全由机器组成的世界中，我们仍然找到理由去感受。 🖤

titans.quote_zh:
钢铁之下的灵魂🐉⚔️

她由瓷器和钢铁诞生，装饰着古老帝国的优雅和未来的精确。

银龙盘旋在她的王冠上，错综复杂的齿轮在她的盔甲下低语，每一个倒影都承载着上千场被遗忘的战斗的记忆。

然而，在冰冷完美的机械背后隐藏着任何工匠都无法创造的东西——人类的灵魂。

她不畏惧时间的流逝，也不追求永生。

因为即使世界忘记了她的名字，她体内的龙也会记得。

钢铁可以保护肉体，但只有灵魂才能使其永恒。

也许人类最美丽的事情是，即使在一个完全由机器组成的世界中，我们仍然找到理由去感受。 🖤

图片：中途8.2
视频：Kling 4.0，15 秒，原生 1080p。
titans.quote_en:
THE SOUL BENEATH THE STEEL 🐉⚔️

She was born of porcelain and steel, adorned with the elegance of an ancient empire and the precision of a future yet to come.

Silver dragons coil around her crown, intricate gears whisper beneath her armour, and every reflection carries the memory of a thousand forgotten battles.

Yet behind the cold perfection of machinery lies something no craftsman could ever create — a human soul.

She does not fear the passage of time, nor does she seek immortality.

For even when the world forgets her name, the dragon within her will remember.

Steel may protect the body, but only the soul can make it eternal.

Perhaps the most beautiful thing about humanity is that even in a world made entirely of machines, we still find a reason to feel. 🖤

Image : Midjourney 8.2
Video : Kling 4.0, 15s, native 1080p.
